correctness.rationale: Published results cover all indices <=3000, all 3001..3200 indices with at most three distinct prime factors, primes <=2^30, and primes above the explicit Hsia-Li-Sun bound. Exact enumeration leaves 165 gap primes across 20 indices; every generated primitive-root coset witness was verified by exact modular arithmetic.

originality.rationale: The strongest directly matching consecutive-index theorem located stops at 3000; the 2024 cyclotomic result covers odd-prime indices but not the twenty composite four-prime-factor indices resolved here. Searches did not locate a later extension through 3200. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with explicit residual source-access risk.

value.rationale: The result extends an established uniform exact-CAC range by 200 subgroup-index values and resolves the first twenty composite-index obstructions with a compact exhaustive certificate of 165 witnesses.
